name: Alyeska Nordic Spa
area: Girdwood (Alyeska Resort, next to the tram)
hoursOrDates: Hydrotherapy daily 10:00-21:00; Twilight entry from 17:00; massage 08:30-19:45; Two Trees Bistro 11:00-20:00. No holiday closures are listed. Dec 24-Jan 1 are peak/holiday dates with higher rates.
cost: Full-day hydrotherapy (arrive before 17:00) from $125. Rates vary by day: Sat, Sun and holiday peak dates cost more, and no exact holiday price is published (a 2024 review cited $119 weekday / $129 Fri-Sun, with higher peak rates). Twilight (after 17:00) is cheaper; the price wasn't shown. Hydro + 60-min massage from $245, with a 16% automatic gratuity on massage. Walk-ups after 17:00 get 10% off full-day access. Promo ALYRECOVER15 gives 15% off hydrotherapy with proof of a mountain activity (lift ticket or tram). AK-resident code AKLOCAL may have expired 31 Mar 2026. Club 587 discount excludes holidays.
groupFit: Good for 6 adults (all must be 18+). Book 6 individual hydrotherapy slots in one cart. Reservations open up to 3 months ahead, so the holiday window is already bookable and weekends and holidays sell out. Massages need 12+ weeks' notice for Fri-Sun and 3+ weeks midweek. Bistro tables for 6+: email twotrees@anordicspa.com. Changing an arrival time goes through reservations; cancel 24 h ahead or pay in full.
notes: Alaska's flagship Nordic spa (~50,000 sq ft): outdoor hot pools, several cold plunges (one 4 ft deep) and waterfalls, Finnish, salt, banya and barrel saunas, a steam room, outdoor fire pits and a relaxation lounge. Steam rises in the rainforest snow. Adults only (18+). No phones or cameras. No re-entry once you leave. Swimsuit required; robe, towels, sandals and locker provided. Credit card required to book but charged on arrival. Arrive within a 30-min grace window; 2 h late counts as a no-show. Same-day spots via first-come waitlist only. Non-hotel guests park in the back overflow lot. Pairs with skiing on Alyeska and Girdwood Nordic trails. The Seward Hwy along Turnagain Arm can close for avalanches or crashes in winter; check 511.alaska.gov. Group: Good for 6 adults (all must be 18+). Book 6 individual hydrotherapy slots in one cart. Reservations open up to 3 months ahead, so the holiday window is already bookable and weekends and holidays sell out. Massages need 12+ weeks' notice for Fri-Sun and 3+ weeks midweek. Bistro tables for 6+: email twotrees@anordicspa.com. Changing an arrival time goes through reservations; cancel 24 h ahead or pay in full.

name: The Alaska Club East - Nordic Spa
area: East Anchorage (5201 E Tudor Rd, East pool deck)
hoursOrDates: Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00 (last reservation 19:30); Sat-Sun 08:00/08:15-18:30 (last reservation 18:00). Holiday hours not posted. Club holiday hours page lists only Thanksgiving, and an older Facebook post said clubs may be unstaffed over Christmas. Call 907-891-7994 or check thealaskaclub.com/hours before 24-25 Dec and 1 Jan.
cost: Non-member single session $95 (90 min). $65 if accompanied by an Alaska Club member. Included in Gold/Platinum memberships.
groupFit: Workable for 6 adults if all are 21+. Each person needs their own online login to book. Bookable up to 45 days ahead. Walk-ins only if space allows. Cancel 6+ h ahead or forfeit the fee. Capacity per slot not stated, so book together early.
notes: Anchorage's in-town Nordic circuit: hot tubs, salt stone sauna, steam rooms, cold plunges and a relaxation lounge, all co-ed. Ages 21+ only. No phones anywhere in the spa (phone lockers provided). Closest true hot-cold circuit to Spenard (~15 min). One Tripadvisor reviewer found the steam room partly out of service. Group: Workable for 6 adults if all are 21+. Each person needs their own online login to book. Bookable up to 45 days ahead. Walk-ins only if space allows. Cancel 6+ h ahead or forfeit the fee. Capacity per slot not stated, so book together early.

name: Adventures by True North AK - Sauna & Polar Plunge
area: Eklutna Tailrace / Knik River area off Old Glenn Hwy (check-in 12303 S Old Glenn Hwy, Chugiak); also Knik River, Cottonwood Lake, Knik Glacier
coordNote: approx: Nominatim matched only the Old Glenn Hwy street in Chugiak, not the house number. The sauna site moves with ice conditions (Eklutna Tailrace / Knik River area)
hoursOrDates: Winter season roughly mid-Oct to mid-Apr, conditions permitting (Dec-Jan falls inside it). Daytime sessions; dates via the FareHarbor booking calendar. Holiday availability ?
cost: From ~EUR 183 (~$200) per group per 1-h session on Manawa; a GetYourGuide listing cites $200 per group of up to 4. Optional round-trip Anchorage shuttle $175 per group. Knik Glacier version is a full ~8-h ATV day at a higher, unpublished price.
groupFit: Mobile sauna seats 4, so 6 means two groups rotating or booking two groups. Cottonwood Lake site takes up to 6, more with a second sauna. Age 8+ (Manawa) or 10+ (company site).
notes: Best 'real Alaska' hot-cold option near Anchorage: mobile Finnish sauna beside glacier-fed water with an optional plunge, lifeguard (Red Cross) on duty, life vests, optional wetsuits, towels and cocoa. Book at least a day ahead. Site may move with ice or weather; open water never guaranteed. Bring swimsuit and water shoes. Free reschedule or refund for weather cancellations; 15+ min late counts as a no-show. Phone 907-691-8909. Group: Mobile sauna seats 4, so 6 means two groups rotating or booking two groups. Cottonwood Lake site takes up to 6, more with a second sauna. Age 8+ (Manawa) or 10+ (company site).

name: Pioneer Peak Saunas (mobile wood-fired rental)
area: Delivers to Mat-Su Valley and Greater Anchorage (could come to the Spenard rental)
coordNote: approx: mobile; point is Mat-Su Regional Medical Center, the company's free-delivery reference point
hoursOrDates: Rental windows (12 h, 2 days, 4-h events). Winter operation implied (no cold showers in winter). Holiday availability ?
cost: Day Escape $499 (12 h, 6 h of wood); 2-Day $899; Nordic Spa Event Package $699 (4 h, staffed, cold plunge tub and ice); Basic Event $599. Add-ons: cold plunge tub $60, extra wood $30, towel and hat pack $75. Drop-in seats $35-40 per 45-60 min at their events. Delivery free within 10 mi of Mat-Su Regional Hospital, then $2/mi, so expect a mileage surcharge to Spenard (~35 mi past the free zone, about $70 at $2/mi, estimate; ask for a quote).
groupFit: Excellent: fits 8+, so all 6 at once at your own rental.
notes: Real wood-fired sauna trailer; about 1 h to heat. Needs a level 20x20 ft parking spot and 20 ft overhead clearance. Ask whether the Spenard rental host allows it. Pair with the $60 cold plunge tub or a snow roll. Contact hello@pioneerpeaksaunas.com. Group: Excellent: fits 8+, so all 6 at once at your own rental.

name: Anchorage Sauna Co. (mobile wood-fired rental)
area: Delivers within Anchorage proper (extra fee for Eagle River and Girdwood)
coordNote: approx: mobile, no fixed address; Anchorage city centroid
hoursOrDates: ? Site still says 'pre-launch' (launch planned Nov 2025, 'Winter 2025' priority booking), so operating status for Dec 2026 is unclear.
cost: $350 weeknight, $400 weekend night, $650 full weekend, $1,300 full week; firewood, delivery and setup included in Anchorage proper. $100 refundable deposit to reserve.
groupFit: Seats 4-6 adults with a private changing room, so it fits the group of 6.
notes: Delivered fully assembled to your house. Needs a flat, truck-accessible 18x9 ft spot. Would be ideal at the Spenard rental if it's actually operating; confirm by email or the site. Group: Seats 4-6 adults with a private changing room, so it fits the group of 6.

name: Seward Saunas (mobile wood-fired rental)
coordNote: approx: mobile, delivered around Seward; Seward town centroid
hoursOrDates: Overnight rentals: drop-off 17:00, pick-up 09:00. Markets itself as year-round, but winter operation isn't explicitly confirmed.
cost: From $400-475 per night; additional nights $50 less. Free delivery within 10 mi of Seward.
groupFit: Very good: Aialik and Chenega models fit 10, Godwin fits 8.
notes: Wood-fired, up to ~200 F, often placed by a river or lake for cold plunges, with a safety briefing on delivery. Only sensible if the group overnights in Seward (2.5 h each way on the Seward Hwy, which has winter avalanche and closure risk). Not recommended for young children. Contact sewardsauna@gmail.com or 907-769-1584. Group: Very good: Aialik and Chenega models fit 10, Godwin fits 8.

name: Hatcher Pass Lodge creekside sauna
area: Hatcher Pass, Talkeetna Mtns (Mi 17.5 Fishhook-Willow Rd, Palmer side, 3,000 ft)
hoursOrDates: Lodge open year-round; sauna typically in the evenings for overnight guests. Holiday hours ?
cost: ~$25/hour per sauna session (user-reported on Tripadvisor; current rate unconfirmed). Rustic dry cabins extra (book via Checkfront).
groupFit: Good: private sauna by the hour. Fit 6 by booking a slot or two; dry cabins sleep small groups (ladders to lofts).
notes: Top pick for XC skiers: wood sauna over a flowing creek, right next to the groomed Nordic trails at Independence Mine/Hatcher Pass. Restaurant serves non-guests lunch and dinner (fondue, soups, hot drinks). Day-visitor sauna use isn't confirmed, so call 907-745-1200. Hatcher Pass Rd is steep and winding: use good winter tires and expect avalanche or wind closures. Cabins have no running water and limited cell service. Group: Good: private sauna by the hour. Fit 6 by booking a slot or two; dry cabins sleep small groups (ladders to lofts).

name: Chena Hot Springs Resort (Rock Lake)
area: FAR - Interior, end of Chena Hot Springs Rd, ~56 mi E of Fairbanks
hoursOrDates: Pool House daily 07:00-23:45 (last entry 23:30); resort says it is open 365 days. No holiday closures listed; call 907-451-8104 ext 4.
cost: Day use: adults 18-59 $20, seniors 60+ $18, ages 6-17 $17, 5 and under free (valid to 20 Apr 2027). Towel $5, locker $0.50.
groupFit: Easy for 6; no reservation needed for day use. Lodging and aurora tours book out over the holidays.
notes: FAR (~7-8 h drive or 1-h flight to Fairbanks + 1-1.25 h drive). Outdoor natural rock-lined hot springs lake (18+ only) steaming at -30 F, plus indoor family pool and hot tubs. Aurora viewing and an ice museum. Winter road requires proper tires; the resort shuttle needs 72 h notice. Combine with Birch Hill/UAF ski trails in Fairbanks. Group: Easy for 6; no reservation needed for day use. Lodging and aurora tours book out over the holidays.

name: Tolovana Hot Springs
area: FAR - Interior, 10-11 mi trail from Elliott Hwy Mi 93 (NW of Fairbanks)
hoursOrDates: Winter season 15 Nov-15 Apr; access only with an advance cabin reservation or paid day-use permit. Reservations open no earlier than 3 months ahead, so late Dec dates open in late Sept.
cost: Winter: Cedar Cabin $190-255, Log Cabin $150-180, Frame Cabin $65-85 per night; day use $40/person (third-party, 2026 guide; operator site unreachable).
groupFit: Good for a strong group of 6 skiers: Cedar or Log cabin fits a small party; book early. Overnight strongly advised.
notes: FAR - the ultimate XC-ski warm-up: ski 10+ mi in (about 1,150 ft down, 1,200 ft over the Dome, 1,100 ft down) to rustic cabins and soaking tubs in a wild valley. Expect -20 to -40 F, short daylight and drifting; backcountry experience needed, and snowmachine haul can be arranged. Trailhead not signposted, so ask the managers for directions. Winter-only alternate trails from Livengood (26 mi) and Murphy Dome (50 mi). Group: Good for a strong group of 6 skiers: Cedar or Log cabin fits a small party; book early. Overnight strongly advised.

name: Manley Hot Springs (greenhouse soaking tubs)
area: FAR - Interior, end of Elliott Hwy (~152 mi from Fairbanks)
hoursOrDates: Resort says open year-round; soaks by appointment. Cabin guests get 24/7 private 1-h soaks; public availability limited when cabins are booked. Winter specifics ?
cost: Non-guests $30/person/hour (groups up to 5) per the resort site; older listings cite $5-10.
groupFit: Max 5 per soak, so 6 means two back-to-back slots. Roadhouse mostly May-Oct (large winter groups by request).
notes: FAR - three concrete tubs inside a lush greenhouse fed by hot springs, very quirky. Long winter drive on the partly gravel Elliott Hwy; carry survival gear. Book personally by email (Jesse@manleyhotspringsresort.com) or phone (907-672-3231). Group: Max 5 per soak, so 6 means two back-to-back slots. Roadhouse mostly May-Oct (large winter groups by request).
